title: Move-In Release Conditions for an Apartment Home Lease
content:
Keys are issued and move-in is recorded only on an approved Apartment Home Lease. Move-in may be recorded only when the security deposit account opened for this lease is in held status.

## Guidance for the desk

**The deposit condition.** The condition is read from the company's record of the Security Deposit Account opened for this same lease, before move-in is recorded. It holds equally for a cash deposit plan and for the Zero-Deposit Guarantee Plan, whose account reaches held when its enrollment is complete under the security deposit charter. A deposit account in any other status does not satisfy it.

**Funds due at move-in.** Funds due at move-in are the prorated rent for the move-in month and, when the move-in day of month is on or after the floor plan's second-month collection day, the full base rent of the following month as well. They are accepted only in the floor plan's instruments accepted for move-in funds.

**Insurance.** When no qualifying proof of renter's insurance is on file at move-in, move-in still proceeds and the liability program fee starts under the lease fee rule.

**What move-in starts.** The move-in date starts the initial Lease Term Agreement and activates the utility account for the lease (Utility Services Program).

## Condition check

| Lease status | Deposit account for this lease | Move-in may be recorded |
|---|---|---|
| Approved | Held | Yes |
| Approved | Not held | No |

## Examples (hypothetical)

- Move-in on the 10th of a month, second-month collection day the 25th: the funds due are the prorated rent for the move-in month only.
- Move-in on the 25th: the funds due are the prorated rent for the move-in month and the full base rent of the following month.
- Move-in on the 27th with no proof of insurance on file: move-in proceeds; the liability program fee starts.
